prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to be consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.2% after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 winning test (though 1 test showed no clear effect).
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) as there is only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Spotlight layout for pet generation waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen using a spotlight layout with progress indicators to show pet generation status clearly. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop or app stalling.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet generation waiting step: Move sign-in screen after pet generation waiting step so users log in right before entering home_intro. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; moving sign-in ensures pet generation completes prior to account linking.)
2: [finish, redesign] Split layout controls center on home intro: Redesign the final home intro screen to a split layout highlighting basic pet controls. (why: 35.2% drop-off at finish step and 3 support emails reported user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Account save reassurance copy on path choice: Add body copy reassuring users that created pets will automatically sync to their account. (why: 8 support messages mentioned concern over reset or missing pets after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop permission guidance on waiting screen: Display background status text with system permission hints during pet rendering. (why: 3 support emails noted app stalling or pet not appearing on desktop.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop background completion notification: Enable optional desktop notification alert when pet generation completes in background. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing users to minimize or forget the app window.)
6: [finish, hint] Shortcut key hint on home intro screen: Add hint text detailing shortcut keys to show, hide, and interact with desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and controlling the desktop pet.)
